alignment: future input features u[t+offset:t+h+offset]; both retained, neither selected by performance
target: nuclear ERK-KTR / contemporaneous image ERK-KTR intensity; future image intensity used only to define the measured target, never as a predictor
eligibility: finite measured values, image intensity>0 and nuclear area>0 throughout continuous history through target; no interpolation or response-amplitude exclusions
fit: direct prediction of target minus current value; equal weight per training CSV; training-only standardization; intercept unpenalized; select penalty by mean per-CSV MSE on calibration day; fixed list order tie-break
temporal_calibration: within each test file, early fit targets <=floor(0.35*(last-first))+first; validation origins >=early_end+20 and targets <=floor(0.65*(last-first))+first; late origins >=validation_end+20; all comparisons on the same late support
local_policies: per-cell additive mean residual from early fit; require >=5 early windows; unguarded applies this offset; guarded applies only if >=3 validation windows, validation RMSE improves strictly and validation absolute-error q95 <=1.01 times baseline; otherwise retain baseline. No late outcomes enter decisions. Do not reinterpret 1% as significance.
local_dimensions: current target-value bands determined by TRAIN 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles
units: days are transport units; cells and overlapping windows not independent replicates; no iid-window p-values
unknown_input_provenance: pulse detection code may fall back to programmed input if optical signal missing; no per-file historical flag in export; retain recorded/programmed provenance uncertainty
scope: secondary cellular prediction and early-local-calibration evaluation; not a direct FD7/FD8 intervention, not a mechanistic state-number inference
drive: persist source archive, frozen source and numerical protocols, audit, atomic residuals and summaries; verify copied bytes
